description: CompressionMHL FFN, grid cell G5 (the best cell inside the 10.8x FFN-parameter budget). H=4 heads, compress 384->48, LUT, decompress 48->384, nap=8 (2^8=256 cells/table), tph=256 tables/head, C=tph*2^nap=65536, independent per-head compression, untied unembedder, 16k steps, device_batch 12 x grad_accum 4 (effective 24,576). 105,100,428 params (FFN 76.4M, 10.79x vanilla). Re-scored under the FIXED validation protocol (see ../../FIXED_EVAL.md): batch size 48 x 100 eval steps, leading 12 rows skipped, batch-size-INDEPENDENT, on the held-out val shard (shard_06542.parquet) from token 0. Rebuilt from config.json (ffn_type=compression) and loaded from checkpoint.pt with 0 missing / 0 unexpected keys.
interpretation: Under the corrected protocol exp_n_0129 sits +0.00581 bpb ABOVE the matched vanilla baseline; the grid summary reported it -0.01996 BELOW. The sign flips. As with the rest of the grid this is the batch-coupled eval, not a change in the model: 0129 trained at device_batch_size 12 and was scored on the first 61,440 val tokens against a vanilla anchor scored on 245,760. It still beats the naive LUT by 0.0220 bpb at a third of its parameters (105.1M vs 330.7M), which is the claim that survives correction.
